properties.description: Large decorative hero SVG used on authentication pages. Contains an organic blob-shaped mask applied over a high-resolution embedded base64 PNG background image (1920x1067). The masked region creates a fluid, asymmetric shape that fills the right/background side of the auth layout. Used as a visual hero element on login and sign-up pages.
visual_elements: full-bleed background photograph/illustration embedded as base64 PNG
properties.purpose: Decorative background hero illustration for authentication screens (login, sign-up)
